english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for financially supporting someone or something with a subsidy.
Use this for financially supporting a person, project, organization, or activity, especially in more formal contexts.
Use this when the funding is financial support, sponsorship, or a subsidy.
Use this when the support specifically involves giving money or funding a project or organization.

examples.english: The government agrees to subsidize this community centre so it can keep running classes.
examples.traditional: 政府資助呢個社區中心，等佢可以繼續開班。
